idle: Use case: ui-mockup / game sprite. Create a single ROUND RADIAL TOWER BUILD SELECTION MENU for a hand-painted watercolor tower defense game, as a production-ready standalone transparent PNG, square canvas, viewed straight-on as a flat UI overlay. Reference images 1 yellow,2 blue,3 red,4 violet are crystal icon shapes and watercolor style to MATCH closely. Design ONE clean circular annular selector wheel divided into EXACTLY FOUR equal broad clickable sectors at cardinal directions. Upper sector contains a miniature YELLOW crystal, left BLUE crystal, right RED crystal, bottom VIOLET crystal. Each icon is the reference's single tall pointed faceted crystal, upright and SAME SIZE, all miniature and centered inside its sector. Thin warm aged brass outer/inner rims and divider lines; sectors matte pale warm parchment with subtle rice-paper watercolor grain. Four sector faces use very slight warm neutral shading, no strongly colored backgrounds. Center of ring is a large perfectly circular TRANSPARENT HOLE that lets the clicked map/build site show through; no center icon, no platform, no tower. Outside the ring is also genuinely TRANSPARENT. All four sectors equal neutral idle state. No labels, no numbers, prices, no text, no runes, no sparkle clouds, no broad glow, no map or scene, no drop shadow bleeding far outside. Crisp silhouette with organic watercolor pigment interior, matches reference crystals. Intended user action: click a building spot, choose crystal/tower by clicking a quarter of this ring.
